narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are no hundreds, so I will push the seven right up against the five.
<bookmark mark='slide'/>Without a gap, the three rod digits fill hundreds, tens and units. They read five hundred seventy two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is a far smaller number, so the gap cannot be closed up.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows the rods for 5, 7 and 2 pushed together with no gap; the place chart slides under them and they land in hundreds, tens and units; the label 572 appears; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Write one rod digit for each place, and leave a gap wherever a place is empty.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Write six thousand thirty seven in rod numerals. Where does the gap go?
